overview: This 1933–1941 file documents U.S. efforts to protect American copyrights in Japan. Embassy studies, legal opinions, press clippings, and correspondence examine treaty rights, a Tokyo copyright ruling, unauthorized translations, pirated books and music, and complaints from authors and publishers.
interest: Connects treaty interpretation and a Tokyo court ruling to specific piracy complaints from American authors and publishers.
